CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_grant_baseball_ticket(p_admin uuid, p_owner uuid)
 RETURNS baseball_gift_tickets
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r baseball_gift_tickets;
BEGIN
  IF COALESCE(auth.jwt() ->> 'email', '') <> 'ji.kim@egnis.kr' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'NOT_ADMIN'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO baseball_gift_tickets (owner_id, granted_by) VALUES (p_owner, p_admin)
  RETURNING * INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.baseball_credit_balance(p_member uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM team_tree_waterings
           WHERE member_id = p_member
             AND watered_date >= date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date)::int
       - COALESCE((SELECT sum(cost) FROM baseball_gift_boxes
           WHERE sender_id = p_member AND kind = 'credit'
             AND created_at >= (date_trunc('month', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')), 0)::int
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.baseball_parts_in_season()
 RETURNS SETOF baseball_parts
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT * FROM baseball_parts p
   WHERE p.weight > 0
     AND (p.season_from IS NULL OR p.season_to IS NULL
          OR (p.season_from <= p.season_to
              AND to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'MMDD')::int BETWEEN p.season_from AND p.season_to)
          OR (p.season_from > p.season_to
              AND (to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'MMDD')::int >= p.season_from
                   OR to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'MMDD')::int <= p.season_to)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.equip_baseball_gear(p_member uuid, p_part text, p_team text)
 RETURNS baseball_equip
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r baseball_equip;
BEGIN
  IF p_part NOT IN ('cap', 'uniform', 'bat') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'BAD_PART'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO r FROM equip_baseball_slot(
    p_member,
    CASE p_part WHEN 'cap' THEN 'head' WHEN 'uniform' THEN 'top' ELSE 'hand' END,
    CASE WHEN p_team IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p_part END,
    p_team
  );
  RETURN r;
END
$function$

functions.name: johari_summary
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.johari_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'about_id', m.id,
    'self_traits', (SELECT to_jsonb(p.traits) FROM johari_picks p WHERE p.about_id = m.id AND p.author_id = m.id),
    'peer_n', (SELECT count(*) FROM johari_picks p WHERE p.about_id = m.id AND p.author_id != m.id),
    'peer_counts', (
      SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(z.trait, z.c), '{}'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT tr AS trait, count(DISTINCT p.author_id) AS c
        FROM johari_picks p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.traits) AS tr
        WHERE p.about_id = m.id AND p.author_id != m.id
        GROUP BY tr
      ) z)
  ) ORDER BY m.created_at), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM members m
  WHERE m.left_at IS NULL AND current_member_id() IS NOT NULL
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.race_has(p_member uuid, p_part text, p_team text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN p_team IS NULL THEN
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM race_garage WHERE member_id = p_member AND p_part = ANY (owned))
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM race_gifts WHERE member_id = p_member AND part = p_part AND team IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()))
    ELSE
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM race_gifts WHERE member_id = p_member AND part = p_part AND team = p_team AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > now()))
    END
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.save_meeting_agenda(p_meeting_id uuid, p_agenda text, p_expected_version integer, p_updated_by text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  m team_log_meetings;
BEGIN
  UPDATE team_log_meetings
     SET agenda = p_agenda,
         agenda_version = agenda_version + 1,
         agenda_updated_at = now(),
         agenda_updated_by = p_updated_by
   WHERE id = p_meeting_id AND agenda_version = p_expected_version
  RETURNING * INTO m;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    SELECT * INTO m FROM team_log_meetings WHERE id = p_meeting_id;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'not_found');
    END IF;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'conflict', 'agenda', m.agenda, 'agenda_version', m.agenda_version,
      'agenda_updated_at', m.agenda_updated_at, 'agenda_updated_by', m.agenda_updated_by);
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status', 'ok', 'agenda', m.agenda, 'agenda_version', m.agenda_version,
    'agenda_updated_at', m.agenda_updated_at, 'agenda_updated_by', m.agenda_updated_by);
END
$function$

functions.name: team_health_summary
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.team_health_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.summary ORDER BY x.period), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM (
    SELECT p.period, jsonb_build_object(
      'period', p.period,
      'n', (
        SELECT count(*)
        FROM team_health_responses r JOIN members m ON m.id = r.member_id AND m.left_at IS NULL
        WHERE r.period = p.period),
      'items', (
        SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(t.k, jsonb_build_object('sum', t.s, 'count', t.c)), '{}'::jsonb)
        FROM (
          SELECT e.key AS k, sum((e.value #>> '{}')::numeric) AS s, count(*) AS c
          FROM team_health_responses r
          JOIN members m ON m.id = r.member_id AND m.left_at IS NULL
          CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(r.answers) e
          WHERE r.period = p.period
            AND jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'number'
            AND (e.value #>> '{}')::numeric > 0
          GROUP BY e.key
        ) t)
    ) AS summary
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT period FROM team_health_responses) p
  ) x
  WHERE current_member_id() IS NOT NULL
$function$
